title: Assessment of Above-Ground Biomass and Carbon Stocks in the Semi-Evergreen Forest Ecosystem of Rema-Kalenga Wildlife Sanctuary
author: Md. Tanvir Hasan
abstract: This study evaluated tree allometric models to estimate above-ground biomass (AGB) across 45 circular sample plots in Rema-Kalenga Wildlife Sanctuary. Mean carbon stock was estimated at 148.6 Mg C/ha, with Dipterocarpus and Artocarpus species contributing over 52% of total ecosystem carbon.

title: Phytosociological Structure, Species Diversity, and Regeneration Status of Tree Species in Khadimnagar National Park
author: Nafisa Anjum Chowdhury
abstract: An ecological inventory recorded 78 tree species belonging to 34 families. Shannon-Wiener diversity index was 3.42. Seedling and sapling density revealed inverse J-shaped diameter distributions, though illegal collection of non-timber forest products poses pressure on secondary growth.

title: Socio-Economic Impacts of Co-Management Committees on Forest-Dependent Livelihoods in Sreemangal Hill Reserves
author: Sabbir Ahmed Khan
supervisor: Prof. Dr. A. Z. M. Manzoor Rashid
abstract: Using participatory rural appraisal (PRA) and household questionnaires (n=120), this investigation evaluated the effectiveness of alternative income generating activities (AIGAs) implemented under USAID co-management frameworks. Beneficiaries reported a 28% reduction in fuelwood extraction dependency.

title: Optimizing Artificial Inoculation Techniques for Agarwood (Aquilaria malaccensis) Resin Formation in Sylhet Private Plantations
author: Rahat Al-Mamun
abstract: Different fungal isolate inoculations (Fusarium oxysporum and Aspergillus flavus) were tested at varying trunk depths on 8-year-old Aquilaria trees. Solvent extraction and GC-MS confirmed sesquiterpene compounds characteristic of grade-A agarwood oil within 14 months of induction.
